feature_graph.comment: Derived from the reviewed private dependency model (regenerate with scripts/ci/generate-suite-ownership.mjs, never hand-edit): an edge from -> to selects to's suites when from changes, i.e. to consumes from - the reversal of the model's depends_on - plus the cross-feature tier rule that every source-bearing feature selects integration, whose own consumers (the composition and CLI layers) join every partial selection accordingly. Unknown edges, shared fixtures and changed selector inputs fail closed to the full set.
